clutch.definition: All the eggs that one bird lays in one nest, counted together.
clutch.example: The blackbird's clutch has five eggs in it.

dpn_foot_in_the_door.definition: A small, easy agreement that is used later as the reason for a much larger one.
dpn_foot_in_the_door.example: The free trial was the foot in the door: the yearly contract came next.

er_validation.definition: An acknowledgement that another person's feeling makes sense from their point of view.
er_validation.example: Validation is not agreement: I can see why that hurt you, without changing his mind.

housekeeping.definition: The team that cleans the rooms, changes the linen and takes away used towels.
housekeeping.example: Could housekeeping bring two more towels, please?

morning.definition: The part of the day from when you wake up until lunchtime.
morning.example: In the morning I drink a glass of milk.

msa_trade_off.definition: What you give up in order to get something else you want more.
msa_trade_off.example: The trade-off was time: more choice now, or a settled life sooner.

notice_period.definition: The amount of time you must give before leaving a job, commonly one or two months.
notice_period.example: I can give one month's notice, so I could start in April.

roadside_assistance.definition: The service that comes to help a broken-down car. It comes through insurance, a manufacturer package or a separate membership.
roadside_assistance.example: Do you know whether my roadside assistance covers a call-out in this area?

roar.definition: The deep loud sound a lion makes. It travels a long way.
roar.example: Leo's roar woke the whole meadow.

sunny.definition: The sun is shining and there are few clouds. A sunny day is a happy day.
sunny.example: It is sunny, so we can play outside.
